name: Barnehage og skole

factors.name: Vold og trusler fra barn og elever
factors.summary: Om rutinene er kjent, om handlingsrommet er tydelig, og om den som var involvert blir fulgt opp.
factors.rationale: 28 prosent av grunnskolelærerne ble utsatt for vold på jobb det siste året – høyest av alle yrker – og 11 prosent opplever det månedlig eller oftere. I undervisningsyrkene samlet økte andelen fra 12 til 18 prosent fra 2022 til 2025. Åtte av ti rektorer i grunnskolen rapporterer slike hendelser, oftest fra noen få av de yngste elevene. I Sverige hadde tre av fire inspiserte skoler mangler i arbeidet med å forebygge vold og trusler mot personalet.
legal_basis: aml § 4-3 sjette ledd (vern mot vold, trusler og uheldige belastninger fra kontakt med andre)
forskrift om utførelse av arbeid kap. 3A (kartlegging og vurdering av risiko, tiltak, informasjon, opplæring og oppfølging ved vold og trusler)
opplæringsloven § 13-4 (fysiske inngrep for å avverge skade)

en.name: Kindergartens and schools
en.description: Add-on module for kindergartens, schools and after-school care. Eight factors with three statements each, plus two questions reported only as counts. The wording is adapted to a kindergarten, a school or both.

vold_og_trusler.name: Violence and threats from children and pupils
vold_og_trusler.summary: Whether the routines are known, whether the room for action is clear, and whether whoever was involved is followed up.
vold_og_trusler.rationale: 28 per cent of primary and lower secondary teachers were subjected to violence at work in the past year – the highest of all occupations – and 11 per cent experience it monthly or more often. Across the teaching occupations, the share rose from 12 to 18 per cent from 2022 to 2025. Eight in ten head teachers in primary and lower secondary schools report such incidents, most often from a few of the youngest pupils. In Sweden, three in four inspected schools had shortcomings in their work to prevent violence and threats against staff.
legal_basis: aml § 4-3 (6) (protection against violence, threats and undue strain from contact with others)
Regulations concerning the performance of work, chapter 3A (mapping and assessing risk, measures, information, training and follow-up for violence and threats)
Education Act § 13-4 (physical intervention to prevent harm)

bemanning_og_vikarer.name: Staffing and substitutes
bemanning_og_vikarer.summary: Whether staffing holds, whether absence is covered, and whether nobody is left alone with too many.
bemanning_og_vikarer.rationale: Certified sick leave in kindergartens was 9.2 per cent in 2025 – nearly 70 per cent above the average – equal to about 1.75 full-time positions in every kindergarten. Fagforbundet describes a vicious circle in which absence is not covered by a substitute, and those who are left become worn out.
legal_basis: aml § 4-3 (workload and time pressure)
the Kindergarten Act and the Education Act with regulations (standards for staffing and teaching staff)

samarbeid_med_foreldre.summary: Whether expectations are clear, whether people get support in demanding cases, and whether time off is respected.
samarbeid_med_foreldre.rationale: Teachers report that contact from parents and pupils outside the normal working day is increasing, and the role of class teacher feels ever broader. At the same time, three in four teachers feel valued by pupils and parents – the cooperation is a resource when the boundaries are clear.
legal_basis: aml § 4-3 (6) (strain from contact with others)

BS-FO-2.skole: When cooperation with parents becomes demanding, I get support from management

BS-FO-3.skole: I don't have to answer parents outside working hours

action_suggestions.title: What can parents expect?
action_suggestions.description: The staff make a short overview of response times, channels and what parents can expect, shared at the start of the year.

action_suggestions.title: Replies during working hours
action_suggestions.description: Messages from parents are answered during working hours; scheduled sending and auto-replies are used outside them.

action_suggestions.title: The manager takes part
action_suggestions.description: The manager takes part in the demanding meetings with parents and takes over the dialogue when it gets stuck.

tilrettelegging_og_inkludering.name: Adaptation and inclusion
tilrettelegging_og_inkludering.summary: Whether people get support and competence to meet children and pupils with special needs.
tilrettelegging_og_inkludering.rationale: From 2018 to 2024, the share of pupils who struggle with Norwegian, are academically weak or have other special needs or behavioural difficulties rose, according to the teachers in TALIS. Classes are more mixed than before. Much of the violence in schools comes from a small number of pupils with particular challenges.
legal_basis: aml § 4-2 (adaptation and competence development)
aml § 3-2 (training)

items.BS-TI-1: I get enough support to work with children or pupils with special needs
items.BS-TI-2: We have access to special education expertise when we need it
items.BS-TI-3: I know who to contact when a child or pupil needs more help than we can give

BS-TI-1.barnehage: I get enough support to work with children with special needs
BS-TI-1.skole: I get enough support to work with pupils with special needs

BS-TI-2.skole: We have access to special education expertise when we need it

BS-TI-3.barnehage: I know who to contact when a child needs more help than we can give
BS-TI-3.skole: I know who to contact when a pupil needs more help than we can give

action_suggestions.title: Shared approaches
action_suggestions.description: The staff agree on three shared approaches for children or pupils who need extra structure, and use them the same way.

action_suggestions.title: Regular meetings with the support services
action_suggestions.description: Regular meeting points with the educational psychological service, the school nurse or the school environment team, with a known contact person.

action_suggestions.title: Competence where it is needed
action_suggestions.description: The manager makes sure the special needs competence is used where the need is greatest, and follows up regularly.

kompetanse_og_fellesskap.name: Skills and community among staff
kompetanse_og_fellesskap.summary: Whether new staff and substitutes are trained, whether there is time for professional conversations, and whether the division of work is clear.
kompetanse_og_fellesskap.rationale: About 2,600 full-time kindergarten teachers are missing to meet the teacher standard, the share of kindergarten teachers has fallen to 42 per cent, and applications to kindergarten teacher education have dropped sharply since 2020. Training new staff and substitutes therefore becomes decisive.
legal_basis: aml § 3-2 (training and instruction)
the Kindergarten Act and the regulations on pedagogical staffing (the teacher standard)

items.BS-KO-1: New staff and substitutes get training before they are responsible for children or pupils on their own
items.BS-KO-2: We have time for professional discussions among the staff
items.BS-KO-3: It is clear how tasks are divided between educators and other staff

BS-KO-1.barnehage: New staff and substitutes get training before they are responsible for children on their own
BS-KO-1.skole: New staff and substitutes get training before they are responsible for pupils on their own

BS-KO-2.barnehage: We have time for professional discussions among the staff
BS-KO-2.skole: We have time for professional discussions among the staff

BS-KO-3.barnehage: It is clear how tasks are divided between educators and other staff
BS-KO-3.skole: It is clear how tasks are divided between educators and other staff

action_suggestions.title: Who does what?
action_suggestions.description: Teachers, skilled workers and assistants go through the division of work together and write it down.

action_suggestions.title: Substitute folder and the first day
action_suggestions.description: A short substitute folder and a fixed run-through on the first day, before the substitute has responsibility alone.

action_suggestions.title: Professional top-up
action_suggestions.description: The manager sets aside fixed time for professional conversations among the staff and protects it.

stoy_kropp_og_pauser.name: Noise, physical strain and breaks
stoy_kropp_og_pauser.summary: Whether the noise level is bearable, whether the equipment suits adults, and whether people get breaks.
stoy_kropp_og_pauser.rationale: Statistics Norway explains the high sick leave in kindergartens partly by the work being physically demanding and involving a lot of contact with people. Kindergarten teachers have the highest sick leave of all occupational groups in kindergartens, 10.8 per cent.
legal_basis: aml § 4-4 (physical working environment factors, including noise)
Regulations concerning the performance of work, chapter 14 (noise) and chapter 23 (ergonomically straining work)
aml § 10-9 (breaks)

items.BS-FY-1: The noise level during the day is manageable
items.BS-FY-2: We have furniture and equipment that let me work in a way that is good for my body
items.BS-FY-3: I manage to take breaks during the working day

BS-FY-1.barnehage: The noise level during the day is manageable
BS-FY-1.skole: The noise level during the day is manageable

BS-FY-2.barnehage: We have furniture and equipment that let me work in a way that is good for my body
BS-FY-2.skole: We have furniture and equipment that let me work in a way that is good for my body

BS-FY-3.barnehage: I manage to take breaks during the working day
BS-FY-3.skole: I manage to take breaks during the working day

action_suggestions.title: Noise map
action_suggestions.description: The staff map when and where the noise is worst, and try out measures such as smaller groups and sound-absorbing materials.

action_suggestions.title: A break that is a break
action_suggestions.description: Fixed breaks in which the employee is relieved and has no responsibility for children or pupils.

action_suggestions.title: Adult height
action_suggestions.description: The manager provides adult chairs, changing tables with a lift and other missing equipment, by a fixed deadline.

vanskelige_saker.name: Difficult cases
vanskelige_saker.summary: Whether people know what to do when they are concerned, and whether they are left alone with heavy cases about bullying and safety.
vanskelige_saker.rationale: Kindergartens and schools have statutory duties when children are not safe and well: the duty to act on bullying and violations, and the duty to inform the child welfare service. The duties are heavy to carry alone, and the factor measures whether they are shared and followed up. We have not found Norwegian figures for the strain; the factor builds on the duties in the regulations.
legal_basis: the Kindergarten Act chapter VIII (psychosocial kindergarten environment, duty to act in § 42) and § 46 (duty to inform the child welfare service)
the Education Act chapter 12 (school environment, duty to act in § 12-4) and § 24-3 (duty to notify the child welfare service)
aml § 4-3

items.BS-VS-3: We have time to follow up cases about the well-being and safety of the children or pupils

action_suggestions.description: The staff go through the routine for concerns and the duty to inform with an anonymised example.

action_suggestions.description: The manager sets aside time in the plan for following up cases, and asks how those who have them are doing.
